verdict.rationale: Mastra is Apache-2.0/Elastic-licensed and can be self-hosted 'anywhere' (mastra-docs-11, mastra-docs-19, mastra-docs-18), which gives users de facto control over where data resides, but there is no explicit region/residency selection feature, data-locality controls, or documentation addressing compliance/residency requirements. Missing for 10: explicit region-selection settings, data-residency compliance docs (e.g., GDPR/data localization options), and any cloud-hosted offering with region choice.
